title: docs(pm-dispatch): the clause-2 label rides the reviewable increment, not the grading stroke
body:
Fixes #13557

## What

One in-place rewrite of the clause-2 gate's duty sentence in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (2 lines changed, net 0): the dispatch seat's duty now stops at recording the one-line determination on the card; the `needs:contract-review` label is attached by the PR creator in the same stroke that creates the reviewable contract increment (draft PR, or the report when it arrives first).

Before:

```text
派发席职责止于:卡上记一行认定、挂 `needs:contract-review`(标签命名审的对象,恒英文)、
停手;⛔ 禁止自查放行。挂标仅当**可复审契约增量已存在**(draft PR,或先到的报告);
```

After:

```text
派发席职责止于:卡上记一行认定、停手;⛔ 禁止自查放行。`needs:contract-review`(标签
命名审的对象,恒英文)由 PR 创建者随**可复审契约增量**同笔挂(draft PR,或先到的报告);
```

The surviving duties keep their meaning (记一行认定 stays the dispatch seat's; the 恒英文 label-naming note now rides the hang sentence), and the abolition sentence plus the open-carrier semantics on the following two lines are untouched.

## Why

The standing maintainer ruling (2026-08-28), single-sourced at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` line 10, verbatim as it stands in the file:

> - ⛔ **不预挂**(维护者 2026-08-28 裁定):可复审增量存在前永不挂标,队列/受阻卡的提前挂已废
>   止 —— 前瞻条款②事实走主文件闸门段的三条既有通道;开载体恒 = 真实待审。

As previously written, the duty list still instructed the dispatch seat to hang the label in the same stroke as the determination — at grading/dispatch time, before any reviewable increment exists. The card's verification comment measured 9 pre-hangs removed in 2 days traceable to this live text. The correction separates the two acts exactly as the card's fix direction states: determination recorded on the card at grading/dispatch; label attached by the PR creator with the increment.

The in-passage word-level tightening SHAPE follows the precedent of PR #13505 and the corrections on #13427 / #13403 (cited as shape precedent only; this edit is judged on its own budget).

## Every `needs:contract-review` occurrence in SKILL.md, adjudicated

Four hits at the base ref; measured again at the head ref:

- Line 147 — kept, compliant as-is: the label is the worked example of gate-semantic labels inside the read-modify-write plus comparative read-back discipline for label writes. No hang-timing instruction.
- Line 589 — kept, compliant as-is: states that the quota-exhaustion exemption and its `needs:contract-review` compensation extend to cards that paraphrase clause-2. That is requirement scope (the review obligation survives paraphrase), not hang timing; timing is owned by the corrected duty sentence and by contract-review.md lines 7-11.
- Line 758 — rewritten (this PR).
- Line 897 — kept, compliant as-is: the director-seat four-duty list names the `needs:contract-review` review chain as a duty area. No hang-timing instruction. (The dispatch prompt located this hit at line 889; the measured position at both refs is 897 — same director-seat passage, and the file is unchanged between the card's measurement ref and this PR's base.)

## contract-review.md line 43 — read, adjudicated, left untouched

The dispatch hypothesis asked whether line 43 (「条款②的 `mode:subagent` 派发照旧恒保留 `needs:contract-review`,免审跳过仅座位自会话成立」) is requirement-retention or label-timing. Measured reading: requirement-retention — subagent-mode clause-2 work cannot claim the self-session review exemption, so the REVIEW obligation is retained; nothing in the line names a hang act or a time point.

Evidence: (a) the line lives in the 降档保险丝(机读) section, whose subject is tier measurement, and its second half contrasts with 免审跳过 — the sentence answers "may the review be skipped?", never "when is the label hung?"; (b) carrier timing is owned by the same file's 载体纪律 section (lines 7-11), including the line-10 ruling above — reading line 43 as label-timing would put the 48-line file in contradiction with itself, while the retention reading keeps it consistent.

The ruling's carrier issue #12887 is unreachable on every read channel (issue page and REST both return 404 — it appears deleted), so this adjudication rests on the file's own structure, per the dispatch's stated fallback. The file is byte-identical across this PR's refs. Residual note for audit #13597 Phase 3: 「派发照旧恒保留」 could be sharpened (for example 恒欠 … 复审) to close the last mis-reading channel; deliberately not done here — the disambiguation is optional under the hypothesis, and the audit-era posture is a minimal governed diff.

Both edited lines measure at most 120 bytes (110 and 114) under the max-line-length rule, and the new line break falls between two CJK characters (renders as nothing).
